title: Durigan: Online Betting Platforms Remaining Active After Deadline Will Be Blocked
seoTitle: Durigan: Online Betting Platforms Blocked After Deadline
subtitle: Durigan warns that betting platforms failing to meet the established deadline will have their access interrupted.
excerpt: A provisional measure banning online betting in Brazil mandates the blocking of sites that continue operating past the deadline, Durigan confirms.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Durigan announced that betting platforms remaining active after the deadline stipulated in the provisional measure will be blocked. This statement comes amidst the prohibition of online betting in Brazil, established by a recently issued provisional measure.

The provisional measure also mandates the return of funds to bettors, as indicated in the accompanying news text.

With the implementation of the ban, operators failing to comply with the established deadline will have their internet access interrupted, following Durigan's directive.

With information from Agência Brasil.
